base_train_cutoff: June 30 of previous year; rolling three calendar years

calibration.method: regularized sigmoid on raw probability log-odds

validation: October-December of previous year; no model refit after threshold selection
neutral_policy: exact-zero training/calibration labels excluded for binary direction; ALL evaluation origins retained. A call on a neutral actual is incorrect; abstention is not a neutral-class prediction.
ridge_shared_rows: same nonzero train dates and six features as classifiers
ridge_recent_control: all labels in three-year window through previous December 31; matches existing refit_2025_native in 2026, extra recent training information disclosed

selection.objective: maximum validation balanced accuracy on called nonzero labels; ties prefer coverage, then smaller margin; fallback full coverage when no eligible candidate

role: adaptive retrospective diagnosis: ALL 2022-2026 periods previously inspected; not a new independent holdout or live forward evidence; no market-context features in this study
